comment: C-first setup probe only, not passing evidence. It uses the source-defined #polyself species prompt to make the Wizard a gelatinous cube (whose first attack is AT_TUCH/AD_PLYS) and creates a hostile ghoul. The frozen input ends with a literal space that C reports as an unknown command, before uhitm.c:damageum can select an attack; the scratch recording is retained only as setup provenance, not a completed helper witness.
